MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

2. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 10
   C. 40.5
   D. 9

3. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 27
   C. 31
   D. 17

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 77
   C. 22
   D. 18

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

11. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 11
   D. 6

12. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

13. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 16
   D. 0

14. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 20

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 105

16. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

17. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

18. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/3

19. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

20. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

21. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

22. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

23. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 14
   C. 2
   D. 49

24. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
